transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?
Most days I wake up with this gray weight on me. Even when I’m at work with the crew or around my kids, I feel low and hollow, like I’m just going through the motions. It doesn’t really let up.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About three years and three months now. It started when the groundskeeping contract changed our schedule—longer days, and it felt like work just took over my life.
During these years, or even before, have you ever had times where you felt the exact opposite—unusually energetic, wired, or on top of the world?
I’m not sure what you mean by “on top of the world.” I haven’t really noticed periods where I felt unusually wired or full of energy.
Over these past three years, have there been any stretches of time lasting two months or more where your mood returned completely to normal?
No. It’s been pretty constant since the schedule changed—about three years and three months now. I can’t think of a stretch where I felt completely back to normal.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in the things you used to enjoy doing?

Yeah. I used to help organize the community garden and music gatherings, but I’ve been avoiding them. I just don’t get much out of it anymore, and other people have had to take over things they used to count on me for.
Before this started three years ago, had you ever experienced any other periods in your life where you felt deeply depressed?
I’m not really sure. I can’t think of another time like this before the last few years.
How has your sleep been over these past few years?
I’m not sure, honestly. I haven’t really paid close attention to my sleep over that time.
Have you been feeling low on energy or unusually tired most days?
Yeah. By midmorning, I feel like I’ve already worked a full day. Even if I sleep in on Sunday, I still drag through basic stuff—loading tools, looking over job plans, even making dinner.
How has your appetite been over this time?
I’m not sure, to be honest. I haven’t really noticed whether it’s changed much.
How have you been feeling about yourself over these past few years?
I’m not really sure what to say about that. I haven’t spent much time thinking about myself that way.
Have you noticed any trouble concentrating or making decisions over this time?

Yeah. I’ve been missing details when I’m planning jobs, and I’m behind on the crew paperwork more than I used to be. I’ve also kind of stopped showing up for the community garden and the music gatherings I helped organize. Other people have had to take over things they used to count on me for.
